slugs.mind-binding: a power that binds or rewrites another mind (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.time-loop: a loop or reset of time that a person carries across (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.area-field: an effect that holds over an area and not a target (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.power-interaction: a power that answers another power: cancel, immunity, counter (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.form-transformation: changing the holder's own body or form (shared slug, PWC9)
slugs.familiar-summon: bound spirits, constructs or summoned servants that act on their own (shared slug, PWC9)
slugs.power-transfer: power passing by death, theft, bloodline or gift (shared slug, PWC9)
slugs.vow-cost: binding vows, contracts or limits that pay for power (shared slug, PWC9)
slugs.item-bound-power: the power lives in a held object or device (shared slug, PWC9)
slugs.soul-state: soul, spirit or afterlife mechanics the body model lacks
slugs.system-interface: a game-like system: points, shop, status screen, levels or a granted interface
slugs.blueprint-craft: learning a design and manufacturing from it with materials and a build process
slugs.construct-upkeep: a made body (simulacrum, golem, suit) that draws on a reserve every minute
slugs.divination-fate: seeing, nudging or reading fate, luck or hidden truth
slugs.dimension-travel: moving a person or thing between worlds, planes or dream spaces
slugs.effect-unknown: the evidence does not say what it does well enough to run
